summary: User was directed to use a recently created website (securedeth.us) to receive crypto funds. The site appears to use a custom RPC/testnet configuration (e.g., Ethereum testnet like Hoodi) to display worthless tokens as if they have value, indicating a fake crypto platform scam.
user_mistake: Being required to use a newly created, obscure crypto website with custom RPC settings to receive funds
prevention: Only use established wallets and exchanges of your own choice / Avoid platforms designated by strangers, especially newly registered domains
